Wasteland Mini Golf (fo4minigolf) - credits and licences
=========================================================

The mod
  Code (the F4SE plugin and tools): GNU General Public License v3.0 - https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html
  Source: https://github.com/evodube/fo4minigolf

Fallout 4 assets
  Some course pieces reuse Fallout 4's own meshes and textures (the Mr. Handy statue, tyres, Nuka-Cola bottles, oil
  drums, plants, rocks and the like). They belong to Bethesda Softworks and are used under Bethesda's terms for mods
  of the same game; they need Fallout 4 to be of any use.

Sounds (Data\Sound\fo4minigolf)
  cup_1.wav     "Drop ball in cup-1.wav" by AGFX - https://freesound.org/s/20428/
                Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0) - https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
                Changes: trimmed, filtered, compressed, levelled, converted to mono 44.1 kHz.
  putt_1-6.wav  "putt.wav" by 170129 - https://freesound.org/people/170129/sounds/408260/
                Licence: CC0 1.0 (public domain) - https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
  putt_7.wav, cup_2.wav
                "Minigolf putt, right into the hole!" by pfranzen - https://freesound.org/people/pfranzen/sounds/512505/
                Licence: CC0 1.0
  cup_3.wav     "golf_putting.wav" by inbeeld - https://freesound.org/people/inbeeld/sounds/21878/
                Licence: CC0 1.0
  wall_*, rim_*, land_*
                "Impact Sounds" by Kenney - https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
                Licence: CC0 1.0
  splash_*, holein_*
                made for this mod (synthesised); part of the mod.
